SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-29-2026 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF THE COURT TO FEB-09-2026 AT 8:30 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF STEVAN ESPITA-SLOAN IS PRESENT VIA ZOOMGOV. DEFENDANT INTERCONTINENTAL MARK HOPKINS HOTEL HOTEL IS PRESENT VIA ZOOM REPRESENTED BY SAMEH NAWAR, GENERAL MANAGER. NO GRANTED ZOOM APPEARANCE FOR THE DEFENDANT ON FILE. DEFENDANT MICHAEL PACE IS NOT PRESENT. NO PROOFS OF SERVICE ON FILE FOR BOTH DEFENDANTS. ***DEFENDANT INTERCONTINENTAL MARK HOPKINS HOTEL WAIVES SERVICE.*** THE PLAINTIFF IN THIS MATTER DISMISSES THE CASE WITHOUT PREJUDICE AGAINST DEFENDANT MICHAEL PACE TO PROCEED AGAINST THE OTHER DEFENDANT. THE COURT ALLOWS THE DEFENDANT INTERCONTINENTAL MARK HOPKINS HOTEL TO APPEAR BY ZOOM AND EXTENDS ZOOM APPEARANCES FOR BOTH PARTIES TO THE NEXT HEARING. ***HON. JOSH M. FREDRICKS RECUSES HIMSELF FROM THIS MATTER.*** SAMAR NEWAR, FOR THE MARK HOPKINS HOTEL, WILL SEND IN AN SC-109 FORM TO THE COURT BEFORE THE NEXT HEARING. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE: JOSH M. FREDRICKS; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
